### To Remember as You Worship
Author: Chuck Swindoll
Site: Insight for Living
URL: https://insight.org/resources/daily-devotional/to-remember-as-you-worship
Passage: Ecclesiastes 5:1-2
Points:
- Guard your steps and remain spiritually alert when approaching God in worship.
- Enter worship primarily to listen, recognizing that the living God is actively communicating.
- Meaningful worship requires a prepared congregation actively engaged in hearing God's truth.
- Strip away empty religious routine and honor God with holy reverence and obedience.

### Measured Speech
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/measured-speech
Passage: Ecclesiastes 5:1-3
Points:
- Approaching God wisely involves entering His presence eager to listen and speaking few words.
- Genuine corporate worship focuses on diligently hearing and applying God's proclaimed Word.
- Hasty prayers and thoughtless speech represent the foolish sacrifices warned against by Solomon.
- Reverence for God's heavenly majesty demands that our words never outrun our careful thinking.
